subject: Culture
title: Gender-Fluid Fashion
description: A quick win: understand Gender-Fluid Fashion.

hook.text: In 2020, Harry Styles wore a ball gown on the cover of Vogue. It was the magazine's first solo male cover.

buildup.text: Gendered clothing is a modern invention. Ancient Romans, Egyptians, and Polynesians wore gender-neutral garments.

discovery.text: Western gender coding solidified in the 1800s. Before that, all toddlers wore white dresses regardless of sex.

twist.text: David Bowie's androgyny in the 1970s was shocking. Today, gender-neutral fashion lines generate billions in revenue.

climax.text: Fashion is the front line of gender politics because it makes identity visible before a word is spoken.

punchline.text: Clothes don't have genders. Cultures assign them.

quiz.question: What did all Western toddlers wear before gendered baby clothing?
